description: Withdrawn Kfir released from the Israeli Air Force Museum at Hatzerim and trucked to Kibbutz Ein Harod Ihud as a monument to the ten pilots the kibbutz produced. The project was driven by kibbutz member Yishai Tsimmerman. Walla dates the installation to 10 November 2021 and the Amud Anan point of interest to May 2022. Neither the serial nor the sub-variant has been published so tail_number is left blank.
